[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45625951/5ec33651469190bbc3dcd9a619c53c3aa1f1bf70.png[/img]

[quote=author] Every word and action carries seductive charm, revealing full elegance in the flow of glances.
“Sister went out today, so it’s just us here today……” [/quote]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45625951/54138411496876331c25d03b969eddbc8149c35f.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45625951/3096a437922a862330806516f6742b1be4ac94ed.png[/img]

[quote=author] Crimson eyes hide shattered pasts. In careful care, affections quietly grow……
“Will this really make you feel comfortable?” [/quote]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45625951/7206e509ae41a2a7fb0238803dbef8a3306aaf55.png[/img]
[h3]🐾 Night Shadow Exquisite·Cat Spirit——Tian Jiao[/h3]
[quote=author] Lively silhouette encountered under the moon, enemy or friend? Beneath the quirky exterior surges millennia-old karma.
“Such a precious gift～I’ll accept it❤Hehe～” [/quote]

The bustling Chang'an during the prosperous Tang Dynasty, with subtle scents wafting through the pavilions and terraces~🏮
